# Events stanza parameters

This reference lists the parameters of the `events` stanza. For instructions on configuring events and sinks, refer to [Configure event sinks](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/configure-sinks).

You can define the `events` stanza only once in a configuration file.

```hcl
events {
  audit_enabled        = false
  observations_enabled = true
  sysevents_enabled    = true
  telemetry_enabled    = false
  sink "stderr" {
    name        = "default"
    event_types = ["*"]
    format      = "cloudevents-json"
  }
}
```

## Parameters

- `audit_enabled` `(boolean: false)` - Specifies whether Boundary emits audit events.

- `observations_enabled` `(boolean: true)` - Specifies whether Boundary emits observation events.

- `sysevents_enabled` `(boolean: true)` - Specifies whether Boundary emits system events.

- `telemetry_enabled` `(boolean: false)` - Specifies whether Boundary emits telemetry events. You must also set `observations_enabled = true` to receive telemetry events.

- `sink` `(block: optional)` - Specifies the configuration of an event sink. You can define `sink` more than once to send events to multiple sinks. If you define no sinks, Boundary sends all events to a default stderr sink. Boundary supports the following sink types:

  - [`file`](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/file)
  - [`stderr`](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/stderr)

  For the parameters shared by all sink types, refer to [Common sink parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/common).

## Default configuration

If the configuration file has no `events` stanza, Boundary uses the configuration shown in the preceding example.
